description: Enter and update requests, tasks and work orders, find and update assets such as signs and storm inlets, attach photos, and start workflows when requests and tasks come in or tasks are completed.

cartegraph_new_request_trigger.description: Runs when a request is entered in Cartegraph, with all its fields. Requests already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

cartegraph_new_task_trigger.description: Runs when a task is entered in Cartegraph, optionally only one for an activity, with all its fields. Tasks already there when the workflow is turned on don't run it.

parameters.description: Only tasks for this activity, such as Patch. Leave empty for every task.
parameters.name: activity

cartegraph_task_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a task in Cartegraph is marked completed, optionally only one for an activity, with all its fields. Runs once per task.

parameters.description: Only tasks for this activity, such as Patch. Leave empty for every task.
parameters.name: activity

parameters.description: The status that means a task is done. Leave empty for Completed.
parameters.name: status
